policy: Reference intakes and safety ceilings are not prescribed supplement doses. No automatic dose until indication-specific evidence and QA.
supported_context: nutritional reference and deficiency risk; deficiency treatment requires clinical/lab context

protocols.amount: Adult RDA varies: commonly 8 mg/day in men, 18 mg/day in menstruating adults; pregnancy 27 mg/day; adult UL 45 mg/day

personalization: Do not infer deficiency from fatigue, hair loss or diet alone; use lab-informed review.
safety: avoid unnecessary iron; excess intake can be harmful
next_review: Define ferritin/CBC triage as clinician-facing information without automated diagnostic cutoffs.
